meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 它会先问你在做什么,提议一套观察类型和概念标签,经你确认后安装成自定义 claude-mem 模式、重启并验证生效,还可选配 Telegram 提醒。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记录什么、新建或修改模式、加观察类型或标签,或为特定记忆配 Telegram 通知时。

say.text: 帮我建一个模式,记录案件规则和教授提示的考点
say.note: 它会追问细节并给出分类草案

say.text: 给「设计决策」这类笔记加 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 它会先确认触发类型再配置

say.text: 先看看现在有哪些模式,再决定要不要新建

howto.what_en: It interviews you about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, then installs and activates a custom claude-mem mode, restarts the worker, verifies it, and can set up Telegram alerts.
howto.when_en: When you want to change what claude-mem remembers, create or edit a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram alerts for certain memories.

say_en.text: Create a mode that records case rules and exam traps my professor flags
say_en.note: It asks follow-ups, then drafts a taxonomy

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts for design-decision notes
say_en.note: It confirms which types trigger alerts

say_en.text: Show me the existing modes before we create a new one
say_en.note: It checks bundled and user modes first
